mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 0.5% consistently compresses equity discount rates and increases risk appetite, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as investors shift capital from fixed income to equities.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS remains below 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained unemployment rate above 5.0% for two consecutive months signals deteriorating labor market health, reducing consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, which drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate broad consumer demand contraction, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as corporate revenue expectations are revised downward.
failure_condition: The joint decline in HOUST and RSAFS fails to predict negative 60-day returns in more than 60% of cases, or the interaction term Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During monetary tightening cycles (FEDFUNDS rising above 0.5% for three consecutive months), the S&P 500 experiences negative forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to increased cost of capital and reduced risk appetite.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS exceeds 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Rising housing starts (HOUST) consistently signal improving consumer confidence and economic activity, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as equity markets anticipate stronger corporate earnings growth.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when HOUST is rising.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 105.0 for two consecutive months indicates weakening manufacturing output, reducing corporate profits and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO falls below 105.0.

mechanism_narrative: A rising industrial production (INDPRO) series consistently indicates expanding manufacturing output and economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as corporate earnings expectations improve.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO is rising.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained CPI increase above 2.5% for three consecutive months signals rising inflation, prompting Federal Reserve policy tightening and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL exceeds 2.5%.
